jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for a Technical Information Specialist to create and maintain diagnostic-related service information for the heavy vehicle industry.
You will develop clear, standardized technical content that enables workshops worldwide to troubleshoot, calibrate, maintain, and repair vehicles efficiently. The information must be structured and integrated into the relevant diagnostic tool (SWS).
The role involves working with technical documentation, diagnostic systems, and cross-functional teams within the aftermarket and E-mobility Diagnostics area.
What You Will Work On
Create and maintain fault code descriptions.
Develop step-by-step diagnostic and calibration guides.
Prepare component information and technical function descriptions.
Create and maintain user interface (UI) texts.
Develop technical illustrations.
Ensure technical information is clear, standardized, and integrated into SWS.
Work with internal tools such as OAS, Catalyst, SWS, Production Tool (PT), and GitLab.
Collaborate with relevant teams using Jira and agile methodologies.

What You Bring
At least 2–3 years of experience in a similar technical writing or technical information role.
Relevant education or experience in Technical Communication, Technical Writing, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in Swedish and English.
Basic technical knowledge and a genuine interest in vehicles.
Experience working with Jira and agile methodologies.
A valid driver's licence.
Experience in the heavy vehicle industry.
Experience with automotive diagnostics and technical service documentation.

Meritorious
Knowledge of AI applications in technical writing.
UX or front-end development skills.
Experience with OAS, Catalyst, SWS, Production Tool, or GitLab.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager  Business Excellence & Process Development - 20788

Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead cross-functional business development initiatives involving IT development, process improvement, digitalisation, and change management.
You will work within a Business Excellence team focused on operational development, Lean methodologies, process management, digital projects, and business system improvements.
The role requires strong project management skills and the ability to drive initiatives across complex, global organisations while ensuring successful implementation and adoption.
What You Will Work On
Lead business development projects focused on digitalisation and process improvement.
Manage cross-functional projects involving business and IT stakeholders.
Report project progress to sponsors, steering committees, PMO, and management teams.
Lead feasibility studies with relevant business stakeholders.
Develop project plans and coordinate project execution.
Prepare requirements specifications for IT tool development.
Drive change management throughout the project lifecycle.
Support implementation and adoption in the organisation together with project sponsors.
Contribute to sharing best practices and improving working methods.

What You Bring
At least 5 years of relevant project management experience.
Experience leading projects within large, global organisations.
Strong experience in IT projects and process development initiatives.
Experience driving change management in complex organisations.
Excellent workshop facilitation skills and the ability to consolidate and present findings clearly.
Excellent presentation and communication skills in both Swedish and English.
Ability to engage and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders.

Meritorious
Knowledge of business systems such as Teamcenter, SAP, and Salesforce (SFDC).
Experience with Lean methodologies and business excellence initiatives.
Experience with digital transformation and organisational development.

jobs.occupation: BI Developer - Data Analytics & Business Intelligence - 20718
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
About the service
Assignment Description
We are seeking an experienced BI Developer / Data Analyst to join a Data & Analytics team working on next-generation analytical solutions using modern data platforms.
You will work in a cross-functional agile team, developing scalable data products and analytical services with a focus on data quality, consistent metrics, semantic modeling, and self-service analytics.
What You Will Work On
Develop and maintain data models using dbt and semantic models in Looker.
Create analyses, KPIs, and data-driven decision-making materials.
Develop dashboards and reports using Looker or similar tools.
Build interactive data visualizations in web applications using JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks.
Work closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into analytical solutions.
Ensure quality, consistency, and clarity in data definitions and metrics.
Collaborate with developers, project managers, UX specialists, and analysts.

What You Bring
Strong SQL and DBT experience, with the ability to independently drive analytics from requirements to delivery.
Experience with Looker, Tableau, or similar visualization tools.
Experience in data modeling and working with large datasets.
At least 5 years of relevant experience as a Data Analyst, Analytics Engineer, or similar.
Proven experience translating business needs into analytical solutions.
Fluent Swedish and English, both spoken and written.

Meritorious
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and BigQuery.
GitHub.
LookML and semantic layers.
AI-assisted development tools such as Copilot or Claude.
Data and analytics product development.
Self-service analytics and user-focused reporting.
JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks such as Vue.js.
Experience building interactive charts and data visualizations.

jobs.occupation: Vi söker budbilsförare med manuelt B-körkort
jobs.description:
Hera Transport AB söker engagerade förare med B-körkort! 🚐

Vill du bli en del av ett växande transportföretag där service, kvalitet och punktlighet står i fokus? Vi söker nu ansvarsfulla och drivna förare som vill arbeta kvällstid.

📍 Arbetsplats: Utgångspunkter från Uppsala och Farsta

🕒 Arbetstid: 16:00 – 23:00
📦 Meriterande erfarenhet:

✅️Tidigare arbete med Airmee

Vi erbjuder dig:

✅️En trevlig arbetsmiljö med ett stöttande team

✅️Möjlighet att växa inom företaget

✅️Arbete i ett företag som värdesätter kvalitet och kundnöjdhet

Vi söker dig som:

✅️Har B-körkort manuelt

✅️Är punktlig, noggrann och serviceinriktad

✅️Har god lokalkännedom i Stockholm med omnejd

✅️Kan arbeta självständigt och ta ansvar

Ansökan:
Skicka din ansökan till jobb@heratransport.se
Märk gärna mejlet med “Jobbansökan Förare”.
Uppsala
Farsta
---

English – Job Advertisement

Hera Transport AB is hiring dedicated drivers with a B driving license! 🚐

Do you want to be part of a growing transport company where service, quality, and reliability are top priorities? We are now looking for responsible and motivated drivers to join our evening shifts.

📍 Starting locations: Uppsala and Farsta 

🕒 Working hours: 16:10 – 23:00
📦 Preferred experience:

✅️Previous work with Airmee

✅️Previous work with Budbee

We offer you:

✅️A supportive and friendly work environment

✅️Opportunities for growth within the company

✅️A workplace where quality and customer satisfaction are key values

We are looking for someone who:

✅️Holds a B driving license manual

✅️Is punctual, detail-oriented, and service-minded

✅️Has good knowledge of Stockholm and surrounding areas

✅️Can work independently and take responsibility

Application:
Send your application to jobb@heratransport.se
Please mark your email with “Driver Job Application”.
Farsta
Uppsala

Swedish bank account

Basic language skills in English or Swedish
